p.s: Nowadays shopping is one of the activities that makes our society lives.
The cities are the main commercial centre, our streets are full of billboard advertising many things and.

Despite this shopping culture, shopping is not always enjoyable, when you need to buy something you have to look for the best price, what is always a work of time, and if you find a shop where the price is cheaper, it must be crowded.
The solution can be in a alternative way of making shops like Internet.
